products.notes: Modular: up to 8 RCA + 8 highlevel in (analog AKM module) or up to 4 stereo SPDIF in; up to 12 RCA out (ESS or AKM output modules) or up to 6 stereo SPDIF out. Built-in stereo SPDIF in (optical 12-96k / coax 12-192k). RCA sens 1-8 V, highlevel 3.5-30 V. Output voltage adjustable 2/4/8 V RMS. SNR analog: ESS 130 dB / AKM 116 dB; digital 122 dB. 3 x ADI DSP. Counts assume fully populated modules. PEQ bands/delay not on page.
